publication.basis: Artifact publication is gated by the supported native architecture, immutable digests, scanning, provenance, manifest, tests, release identity, exact source commit and manual authorization. No specific host is an input to publication.

deployment_acceptance.scope: Per-host and separate from publication: resource capacity, Docker Engine/Compose compatibility, HTTPS, persistence, backup/restore and recovery on the actual host, using the published images (BETA-RUNTIME-001).

candidate_hosts.status: candidate; not accepted; not probed by this repository
